title: Closed Loop: software and modeling fingerprint demo
description: Software for the Closed Loop method: look for patterns in data, try hard to kill them with matched fakes, and keep only what survives. Includes the Closed Loop app and a one-command demo (demo/modeling_fingerprint) that reruns a locked test on public WHO and UN IGME data: the method's quarter-turn lenses separate agency-smoothed infant-death estimates from raw registered counts, beyond what momentum alone explains (56 countries, 2000-2019).
